about: Named cases for the grounding judge (citation_checks.judge_grounding), added 2026-10-30 from the plan A.8 defects. Each case is a question, a few short chunks, and the answer segments as parse_citations returns them, before lead-ins are folded. 'want' gives the verdicts each judged claim may get, after folding. Claim lines are taken from stored answers (source given); chunks are short stand-ins so a knowledge-base edit cannot move a case. Run with: uv run python judge_check.py cases (paid, gpt-4o-mini; --estimate first). The free half, folding, is in selftest.py. A case with an open field is a known defect, kept so a fix can be measured; judge_check.py prints its failures as OPEN. On 2026-10-30 (lead-ins folded, 3 reps) J02 and J10 passed 2 of 3 and every other case not open passed 3 of 3.
